<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>{{ARTICLE_TITLE}} - xundei's blog</title>
    <meta name="description" content="{{META_DESCRIPTION}}">
    <meta name="keywords" content="{{ARTICLE_TAGS_STR}}">
    <link rel="canonical" href="{{CANONICAL_URL}}">
    <meta property="og:title" content="{{OG_TITLE}}">
    <meta property="og:description" content="{{OG_DESCRIPTION}}">
    <meta property="og:type" content="article">
    <meta property="og:url" content="{{OG_URL}}">
    <meta property="og:site_name" content="xundei's blog">
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary">
    <script type="application/ld+json">
        {{JSON_LD}}
    </script>
    <link rel="preload" href="https://cdn.bootcdn.net/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css" as="style" onload="this.onload=null;this.rel='stylesheet'">
    <noscript><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.bootcdn.net/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css"></noscript>
    <link rel="preload" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/styles/github-dark.min.css" as="style" onload="this.onload=null;this.rel='stylesheet'">
    <noscript><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/styles/github-dark.min.css"></noscript>
    <!-- ===== 新增不蒜子统计脚本（页面 PV） ===== -->
    <script defer src="//cdn.busuanzi.cc/busuanzi/3.6.9/busuanzi.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        .article-full-content a:not(:has(img)) {
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            color: var(--link-color);
            transition: color 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
            padding: 0 2px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: transparent;
            word-break: break-all;
        }
        .article-full-content a:not(:has(img)):hover {
            color: var(--w-100);
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.2);
        }
        .article-full-content a:not(:has(img))::before {
            content: none !important;
        }
        .article-full-content a:not(:has(img))::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a1c4fd, #c2e9fb);
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transform-origin: right;
            transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1);
        }
        .article-full-content a:not(:has(img)):hover::after {
            transform: scaleX(1);
            transform-origin: left;
        }
        .toc-list a {
            color: var(--w-80) !important;
            background: none !important;
            -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
            background-clip: unset !important;
            position: static !important;
        }
        .toc-list a:hover {
            color: var(--primary-color) !important;
            transform: translateX(5px) !important;
        }
        .toc-list a::before,
        .toc-list a::after {
            content: none !important;
        }
        .link-confirm a {
            color: #a3c8ff !important;
            background: none !important;
            -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
            background-clip: unset !important;
            position: static !important;
        }
        .link-confirm a::before,
        .link-confirm a::after {
            content: none !important;
        }
        .article-footer a {
            color: var(--link-color) !important;
            background: none !important;
            -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
            background-clip: unset !important;
            position: static !important;
            text-decoration: underline;
            text-underline-offset: 3px;
        }
        .article-footer a::before,
        .article-footer a::after {
            content: none !important;
        }

        :root {
            --glass-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            --glass-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            --primary-color: #4285F4;
            --text-color: #333;
            --light-text: #fff;
            --transition: all 0.3s ease;
            --blur-amount: 12px;
            --code-bg: #1e1e1e;
            --code-copy-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            --code-copy-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            --success-color: #4CAF50;
            --error-color: #f44336;
            --scrollbar-width: 10px;
            --glow-color: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.7);

            --aurora-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #B8D8E3 0%, #D4C5D9 50%, #E8D5D0 100%);
            --aurora-primary: #7BA7BC;
            --aurora-secondary: #C4A6C2;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
        }

        body {
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center;
            background-repeat: no-repeat;
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: var(--text-color);
            position: relative;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            background-attachment: fixed;
            transition: background-image 1.5s ease-in-out;
            background-color: transparent;
            background-image: none;
        }

        .aurora-background {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
            background:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)),
                var(--aurora-gradient);
            transition: opacity 0.8s ease;
            opacity: 1;
            will-change: opacity;
        }
        .aurora-background.fade-out {
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 1.2s ease;
        }
        .aurora-background.hidden {
            display: none;
        }

        .brightness-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.8s ease;
            background: transparent;
        }
        .brightness-overlay.active {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 20px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .aurora-orb {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            pointer-events: none;
            will-change: transform;
        }
        .aurora-orb-1 {
            width: min(600px, 80vw);
            height: min(600px, 80vw);
            background: var(--aurora-primary);
            opacity: 0.25;
            filter: blur(120px);
            left: 10%;
            top: 5%;
            animation: orb1-drift 22s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .aurora-orb-2 {
            width: min(500px, 65vw);
            height: min(500px, 65vw);
            background: var(--aurora-secondary);
            opacity: 0.20;
            filter: blur(100px);
            right: 5%;
            bottom: 10%;
            animation: orb2-drift 26s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .aurora-orb-3 {
            width: min(450px, 55vw);
            height: min(450px, 55vw);
            background: var(--aurora-primary);
            opacity: 0.15;
            filter: blur(130px);
            left: 40%;
            top: 40%;
            animation: orb3-drift 30s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .aurora-orb-4 {
            width: min(300px, 40vw);
            height: min(300px, 40vw);
            background: var(--aurora-secondary);
            opacity: 0.18;
            filter: blur(80px);
            left: 55%;
            top: 15%;
            animation: orb4-drift 18s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes orb1-drift {
          0% { transform: translate(-5%, 0%) scale(1); }
          33.3% { transform: translate(15%, 12%) scale(1.15); }
          66.7% { transform: translate(5%, 20%) scale(0.9); }
          100% { transform: translate(-8%, 3%) scale(1.08); }
        }
        @keyframes orb2-drift {
          0% { transform: translate(8%, -5%) scale(0.9); }
          33.3% { transform: translate(-10%, 10%) scale(1.12); }
          66.7% { transform: translate(5%, -8%) scale(1); }
          100% { transform: translate(12%, 5%) scale(1.08); }
        }
        @keyframes orb3-drift {
          0% { transform: translate(-10%, -8%) scale(1.05); }
          33.3% { transform: translate(20%, 5%) scale(0.88); }
          66.7% { transform: translate(-5%, 15%) scale(1.1); }
          100% { transform: translate(10%, -3%) scale(0.95); }
        }
        @keyframes orb4-drift {
          0% { transform: translate(15%, 10%) scale(0.85); }
          33.3% { transform: translate(-8%, -5%) scale(1.1); }
          66.7% { transform: translate(10%, 8%) scale(0.95); }
          100% { transform: translate(-12%, 15%) scale(1.05); }
        }

        .loading-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            z-index: 10001;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
            opacity: 1;
        }
        .loading-overlay.fade-out {
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .loading-overlay.hidden {
            display: none;
        }
        .loading-card {
            background: rgba(30, 60, 120, 0.55);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(100, 160, 240, 0.45);
            border-radius: 18px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), 0 0 30px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.35);
            padding: 35px 30px 25px;
            width: 320px;
            max-width: 85vw;
            text-align: center;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            animation: loadingPopIn 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }
        @keyframes loadingPopIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.85); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
        }
        .loading-card .loader {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border-top: 4px solid #5badf5;
            border-right: 4px solid #3d8ef7;
            animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
        }
        .loading-card .loading-text {
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .loading-card .loading-subtext {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            min-height: 18px;
        }
        .loading-progress-container {
            width: 100%;
            height: 5px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .loading-progress-bar {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3d8ef7, #5badf5, #7dc8f8);
            background-size: 200% 100%;
            border-radius: 10px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            animation: progressShimmer 2s linear infinite;
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(66, 150, 244, 0.5);
        }
        @keyframes progressShimmer {
            0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
            100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
        }
        @keyframes spin {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        .glass {
            background: var(--glass-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-amount));
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-amount));
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow);
            padding: 20px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .reading-time {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--w-70);
            margin-top: 0px;
        }
        .back-btn {
            position: fixed;
            top: 20px;
            left: 20px;
            background: var(--primary-color);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            z-index: 100;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }
        .back-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--glow-color);
        }
        .article-container {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 60px auto 40px;
        }
        .article-header {
            padding-bottom: 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }
        .article-title {
            font-size: 2.2rem;
            color: var(--w-100);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        .article-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            color: var(--w-70);
            font-size: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 5px 10px;
        }
        .article-tags-bar {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 6px;
            margin-top: 12px;
        }
        .article-tags-bar .article-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 3px 12px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.2);
            color: var(--w-85) !important;
            border: 1px solid rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.25);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-decoration: none;
            background-image: none !important;
            -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
            background-clip: unset !important;
        }
        .article-tags-bar .article-tag:hover {
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.4);
            border-color: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.5);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.25);
        }
        .article-full-content {
            color: var(--w-90);
            line-height: 1.8;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            word-wrap: break-word;
            overflow-wrap: break-word;
            word-break: break-word;
        }
        .article-full-content h2 {
            font-size: 1.7rem;
            margin: 30px 0 20px 0;
            color: var(--w-100);
            position: relative;
            padding-left: 16px;
        }
        .article-full-content h2::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 6px;
            height: 60%;
            background: var(--primary-color);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .article-full-content h3 {
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            margin: 28px 0 18px 10px;
            color: var(--w-93);
            position: relative;
            padding-left: 15px;
        }
        .article-full-content h3::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 5px;
            height: 55%;
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.85);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .article-full-content h4 {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            margin: 24px 0 14px 20px;
            color: var(--w-85);
            position: relative;
            padding-left: 14px;
        }
        .article-full-content h4::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 4px;
            height: 50%;
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.7);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .article-full-content h5 {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            margin: 20px 0 10px 30px;
            color: var(--w-78);
            position: relative;
            padding-left: 12px;
        }
        .article-full-content h5::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 3px;
            height: 40%;
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.55);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .article-full-content h6 {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            margin: 18px 0 8px 38px;
            color: var(--w-70);
            position: relative;
            padding-left: 10px;
        }
        .article-full-content h6::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 2px;
            height: 35%;
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.45);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .article-full-content p { margin-bottom: 25px; }
        .article-full-content ul,
        .article-full-content ol { margin-bottom: 25px; padding-left: 30px; }
        .article-full-content ul li,
        .article-full-content ol li { margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 10px; }
        .article-full-content pre {
            position: relative;
            background: var(--code-bg);
            color: #dcdcdc;
            padding: 50px 20px 20px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            margin: 25px 0;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            max-width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            transition: max-height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
        }
        .article-full-content pre.code-folded {
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .article-full-content pre.code-folded::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 60px;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, var(--code-bg) 85%);
            pointer-events: none;
            border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .article-full-content code {
            font-family: 'Fira Code', 'Courier New', monospace;
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.12);
            color: var(--code-inline-color);
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 0.95em;
            border: 1px solid rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.2);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            white-space: pre-wrap;
            word-break: break-word;
            overflow-wrap: break-word;
        }
        .article-full-content pre code {
            background: none;
            padding: 0;
            display: block;
            overflow-x: auto;
            color: inherit;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 0;
            white-space: pre;
        }
        .article-full-content table {
            display: block;
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow-x: auto;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin: 25px 0;
        }
        .article-full-content th,
        .article-full-content td {
            padding: 8px 12px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            word-break: break-word;
        }
        .code-language {
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            left: 10px;
            color: var(--w-60);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .copy-btn,
        .fold-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            background: var(--code-copy-bg);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 6px 12px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            transition: var(--transition);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
            z-index: 3;
        }
        .copy-btn {
            right: 10px;
        }
        .fold-btn {
            right: 100px; /* 防止与复制按钮重叠 */
        }
        .copy-btn:hover,
        .fold-btn:hover {
            background: var(--code-copy-hover);
            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--glow-color);
        }
        .copy-btn.success { background: var(--success-color); color: white; }
        .copy-btn.error { background: var(--error-color); color: white; }
        .article-full-content img {
            max-width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            border-radius: 10px;
            margin: 25px 0;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            padding: 10px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            transition: all 0.3s ease, opacity 0.5s ease;
            display: block;
        }
        .article-full-content img.lazy-img {
            min-height: 180px;
            opacity: 0.35;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            animation: placeholderPulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes placeholderPulse { 0%,100%{opacity:0.25}50%{opacity:0.5} }
        .article-full-content img.lazy-loaded { opacity:1; animation:imgReveal 0.55s ease-out forwards; }
        @keyframes imgReveal { from{opacity:0.35;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
        .article-full-content img.lazy-error {
            min-height:120px;
            opacity:0.7;
            background:rgba(244,67,54,0.15);
            border:1px dashed rgba(244,67,54,0.4);
        }
        .article-full-content img:hover { box-shadow:0 0 20px var(--glow-color); }
        .article-full-content blockquote {
            border-left:4px solid var(--primary-color);
            padding:10px 20px;
            margin:25px 0;
            background:rgba(66,133,244,0.1);
            border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;
            color: var(--w-90);
        }

        .lightbox { display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.9); z-index:1000; justify-content:center; align-items:center; animation:fadeIn 0.3s ease; }
        .lightbox img { max-width:90%; max-height:90%; border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(66,133,244,0.5); transition:transform 0.3s ease; }
        .lightbox-close,.lightbox-rotate-cw,.lightbox-rotate-ccw { position:absolute; top:20px; color: var(--w-100); cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.3s ease; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border:none; border-radius:50%; width:44px; height:44px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.5rem; }
        .lightbox-close { right:30px; }
        .lightbox-rotate-cw { right:90px; }
        .lightbox-rotate-ccw { right:150px; }
        .lightbox-close:hover,.lightbox-rotate-cw:hover,.lightbox-rotate-ccw:hover { color:var(--primary-color); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2); box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--glow-color); }
